newsitem.title: USA: Schering-Plough to buy back common shares.
newsitem.headline: Schering-Plough to buy back common shares.

text.p: Schering-Plough Corp said its board authorized a program to repurchase up to $500 million in common stock, depending on market conditions.
The company said the buyback decision stems from its strong liquiidy and expectations of solid earnings growth.

Schering said it believes its stock represents good value. The company has completed eight share repurchase programs since 1983, buying back the equivalent of more than 182 million shares at a cost $3.9 billion. The company said, at the current price, it would have a market value of about $10.8 billion.
As of June 30, the company had 369,678,128 shares outstanding. Merrill Lynch will be sole broker on the transactions.
